project: RGM ManageBAC Portal — Oversight Data Connections

tasks.title: Add program_chair to all shared backend routes used by oversight dashboard
tasks.description: 15 routes have director/principal/management but are missing program_chair. These include /hod/placement-summary, /student-placements verify+delete, /mentor-meetings/department, /hod/mentoring-compliance, /leaderboard/hod, /documents/*, /notices/broadcast, /academic-duties/* approve/reject. Without this, program_chair gets 403 on all placement and meeting log tabs.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: program_chair can access all oversight dashboard tabs without 403. Backend build passes.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(backend): add program_chair to all shared oversight routes

tasks.title: Oversight: verify student-placements GET scoping for director/program_chair
tasks.description: GET /student-placements line 8377: role check excludes program_chair from seeing all placements (falls into else branch, treated as student). Fix: add program_chair to the admin/principal/director/management group so they see all placements without department filter.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: program_chair sees all student placements in oversight dashboard. Build passes.
tasks.commit_msg: fix(backend): program_chair sees all placements in GET /student-placements

tasks.title: Oversight page: show search bar in certifications/students/faculty tabs
tasks.description: The department search input is currently only shown when viewMode is not 'powerbi', but it's hidden inside the hidden tab nav block. Move the search bar to above the tab content area so oversight users can filter by department in all tabs.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Department search bar visible in all oversight tab views. Build passes.
tasks.commit_msg: feat(oversight): show department search bar above tab content in all views
